items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: After I had worked with Joe Glaser on the Street and did such a great job down there, he wanted --

ctx.x: It would be a great thing for those places to have some of those tapes, and some of the things that we made on transcriptions and stuff that's just laying out in the warehouse. And they don't know what to do with it, you know.
After that -- now this is what leads up to the Louie Armstrong thing. After I had worked with Joe Glaser on the Street and did such a great job down there, he wanted --
He and I became real good friends then, you know. I used to meet him and we to go walk with -- Ed Sullivan (inaudible).
